title: How Thick Is the Sierpiński Triangle?
summary: Although the Sierpiński triangle has planar area $0$, it is uniformly non-flat: at every point and every scale, its nearby points span a two-dimensional region of comparable size. We prove a sharp version of this statement, showing that the Feng--Wu thickness of $E$ is exactly $\sqrt{3}/6$, the inradius of a unit equilateral triangle.
